page_title: Make Passport Photo Online: Passport/VISA/ID Photo DIY Tool

sources.entry: AI Passport Photo - Take A Photo with Your Mobile Phone and Get Your Passport Photo in Seconds. #freemium

summary.name: AI Passport Photo
summary.one_liner: An online tool that turns a phone photo into a passport, visa, or ID photo that meets size and background requirements for many countries.
use_cases: Make a US passport photo at home
Get a visa photo for a foreign application
Create a green card or F1 OPT photo
Produce a passport photo for a child
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes a photo taken with a mobile phone, checks it against photo requirements, automatically fixes the background, and crops it to the required size. It states it can generate a compliant photo in about 3 seconds. A preview is free, and the user pays to download. The page lists size presets for the US (passport, visa, green card, F1 OPT, DV lottery), Canada, China, Mexico, Taiwan, Germany, India, France, Japan and Australia. It provides digital files only and does not print photos; users print sheets at photo studios, drugstores or convenience stores.
notable: Automatic background correction and cropping to country-specific sizes
Checks photo conditions and gives guidance when a photo is not qualified
Free preview, pay only when satisfied
Covers about 20 country and document presets
caveats: Digital download only; the service does not print photos
Full download requires payment; the free tier is a preview
The page claims 100% acceptance and refunds if rejected, but these are vendor claims and terms are not stated on the page
